words.sentence: Go ahead and start the meeting without me.
words.sentence_zh: 你们先开会吧，不用等我。

words.sentence: The local authority fixed the road last week.
words.sentence_zh: 地方政府上周修好了这条路。

words.sentence: The door is automatic, so it opens by itself.
words.sentence_zh: 这扇门是自动的，会自己打开。

words.sentence: The stadium has a capacity of 80,000 people.
words.sentence_zh: 这座体育场能容纳八万人。

words.sentence: She is the chief engineer of the new project.
words.sentence_zh: 她是这个新项目的首席工程师。

words.sentence: He cited two studies to support his idea.
words.sentence_zh: 他引用了两项研究来支持他的观点。

words.sentence: Water boils at 100 degrees at sea level, but not high up.
words.sentence_zh: 水在海平面100度沸腾，在高处则不然。

words.sentence: The teacher dismissed the class ten minutes early.
words.sentence_zh: 老师提前十分钟下了课。

words.sentence: The report shows a growing inequality in pay.
words.sentence_zh: 报告显示薪酬不平等在扩大。

words.sentence: A healthy lifestyle includes exercise and good sleep.
words.sentence_zh: 健康的生活方式包括锻炼和好的睡眠。

words.sentence: This factory manufactures parts for electric cars all over the world.
words.sentence_zh: 这家工厂为全世界的电动汽车生产零件。

words.sentence: Each participant in the study received a small gift at the end.
words.sentence_zh: 研究里的每位参与者最后都收到了一份小礼物。

words.sentence: There is little prospect of rain this week.
words.sentence_zh: 这周下雨的可能性很小。

words.sentence: English is a basic requirement for this job.
words.sentence_zh: 英语是这份工作的基本要求。

words.sentence: Birds seek warm places when the cold winter comes each year.
words.sentence_zh: 每年寒冬来临时，鸟类会寻找温暖的地方。
